propositions: Plan review lacks a criterion checking whether a ticket's own acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable, so contradictions surface only mid-implementation.

A new 1-TURN advisory coherence criterion 'ac-satisfiability' is added to detect set-quantification contradictions in three shapes: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality.
G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because the sibling roster it receives carries only ids and titles, silencing the finding; the roster must include each child's acceptance-criteria items.
The roster-building expression is duplicated across three non-test callers (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py) and is single-sourced into a shared build_sibling_roster helper.
The roster is moved into the byte-stable system prompt prefix (sent once) instead of per-pairing instructions, and its token cost is included in the parent_tokens prefix estimate.
G3's posture and threshold and Pass-2's internal_conflict verifier axis are deliberately left unchanged pending dogfooding data.
